lines.text:
Flying for the First Time

Ahmad was excited but nervous. It was his first time flying, and he arrived at the airport two hours before his flight.

First, he went to the check-in desk. The airline agent asked for his passport and booking reference. She printed his boarding pass and put a luggage tag on his suitcase before sending it down the conveyor belt to be loaded onto the plane.

Next, Ahmad walked to the security checkpoint. He placed his backpack, phone, and belt in a plastic tray on the X-ray machine. A security officer asked him to walk through the metal detector. Everything was fine, so he collected his things and continued.

In the departure lounge, Ahmad checked the departure board for his gate number. His flight to Istanbul was on time. He had an hour to wait, so he bought a sandwich at a café and exchanged some money at the currency exchange counter.

When boarding was announced, Ahmad walked to Gate 14. He scanned his boarding pass and walked down the jet bridge to the aircraft. A flight attendant welcomed him and helped him find his seat — 22A, a window seat.

During the flight, the captain made an announcement about the flying time and weather. Ahmad watched a film on the in-flight entertainment screen and had a small meal served by the cabin crew.

When the plane landed, Ahmad followed the signs to passport control. After collecting his luggage from the baggage carousel, he walked through customs and into the arrivals hall. His uncle was there waiting with a big smile.
